verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official, open-source CLI (firebase-tools), documented at firebase.google.com/docs/cli. It deploys code and assets, runs a local Hosting server, works with database data, and imports/exports Auth users. It also provides `login:ci` to generate tokens for non-interactive environments, which suits automated and agent-driven workflows. The functions docs describe one-command deploys from the command line, and a community user independently cites the CLI as part of their production workflow. Missing for 10: evidence of machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output or other CLI features designed specifically for agents.
